# Voluntary Recall: Honey Oat Granola Bars

Fernhollow Foods Co.

Notice date: September 20, 2026

Fernhollow Foods Co. is voluntarily recalling some of its Honey Oat Granola Bars because the ingredient list on the wrapper does not declare peanuts. People with a peanut allergy could have a serious reaction if they eat the product. We will refund the full price of every affected product.

## 1 Affected products

Product: Honey Oat Granola Bars

Item code: GB-240

Lot numbers: L5210 to L5240

Sales period: August 20, 2026 to September 18, 2026

Where sold: grocery stores in the Northeast and our online shop

The affected lots are listed below. The lot number is printed on the bottom of the box.

1. Lots L5210 to L5219 (best by March 12, 2027)
2. Lots L5220 to L5229 (best by March 19, 2027)
3. Lots L5230 to L5240 (best by March 26, 2027)

The number of affected packs by size is:

| Pack size | Packs affected |
| --- | --- |
| Single bar | 4,200 packs |
| 6-bar box | 2,400 packs |
| 12-bar box | 1,100 packs |
| Total | 7,700 packs |

## 2 How to get a refund

If you have GB-240 bars, do not eat them. Send them to us with the prepaid label from our website, and we will refund the price once they arrive.

Refund requests accepted until: December 25, 2026

## 3 Contact

Fernhollow Customer Care: 1-800-555-0162 (9 a.m. to 6 p.m., Monday to Saturday)

For help with a refund, call Customer Care (1-800-555-0162).

We sincerely apologize for any concern this may cause.

Fernhollow Foods Co., Quality Assurance
